shots.description: One entry per shot in scenes_plan.shots, in the SAME order. Every shot must appear, even with an empty characters[] array.

shotId.description: MUST match a shots[].id from scenes_plan exactly.

characters.description: Every anchored/recurring character physically present in this shot and their current appearance state as of this shot. Empty if no recurring character is present.

appearance.description: FULL current wardrobe + props-held + condition (dirt/wet/wounds/hair) as of THIS shot — a complete, standalone description, not a diff against a prior shot.

signature.description: Short, stable lowercase key for this exact appearance state, e.g. 'lara__jacket-off__torch'. Reused verbatim while unchanged; changes only when the appearance changes.

changedThisShot.description: One short phrase naming the delta applied at this exact shot (e.g. 'sheds jacket'), or the literal string 'none' if this shot carries the character's prior state forward unchanged.
